_what: The signed field reader Sext(SRA(w,k),n) and every guard that keeps it sound. Each mutant must CHANGE BEHAVIOUR -- an earlier G3 rejected a dynamic sign position both before and after, so no test could kill it and it proved nothing.

mutants.name: G2 dynamic field position accepted as k=0
G3 dynamic sign position guessed instead of refused
G4 the signed reader form removed
G5 self-dependency no longer fails the slice
S1 the rewrite reads the field one bit too high
mutants.old: auto res = resolve(resolve, wd, k, k + n, 0);
mutants.new: auto res = resolve(resolve, wd, k + 1, k + n + 1, 0);

mutants.name: S2 the rewrite drops the field's top bit
mutants.old: auto res = resolve(resolve, wd, k, k + n, 0);
mutants.new: auto res = resolve(resolve, wd, k, k + n - 1, 0);
